rows.behavior: README.md says what kmctl is, gives the install line and the plugin install step, and links every docs page.
rows.fails_when: README.md lacks `uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/Knowledge-management` or `kmctl plugin install`, or a page under docs/ is not linked from it

rows.behavior: docs/ holds at least one page in each Diataxis folder (tutorials, how-to, reference, explanation), and kmctl check passes on the repository.
rows.fails_when: any of the four folders has no page besides its index, or kmctl check run on the repository root exits nonzero

rows.behavior: The reference page names every kmctl command and subcommand that --help lists.
rows.fails_when: a command or subcommand from kmctl's Typer app is missing from the reference page

rows.behavior: .okf/architecture/overview.md has a Depicts section naming every invariant in the manifesto, and every id it names resolves.
rows.fails_when: an invariant id from .okf/manifesto.md is missing from the Depicts section, or the section names an I-id the manifesto lacks

rows.behavior: The .okf bundle with the new architecture section passes the okf validator in strict mode, and the root index links the section.
rows.fails_when: okf_validate --strict reports a problem, or .okf/index.md does not link architecture/

rows.behavior: The pages were written with the write-docs skill, each command on them was run and its real output pasted, kmctl plugin install ran only with isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME, and GitHub-only steps say they come from action.yml and the shipped workflow.
rows.fails_when: a page shows output no run produced, guesses a command or URL, or the plugin install step touched the operator's config
